findings.title: Preserve Mono quantization for authored rules when no level profile exists
findings.evidence: An unchanged public bind_defaults consumer with no profiles and StyleDefaults::mono bg Role::Custom(Color::Indexed(37)) resolves Black on parent 34f73e3 and Indexed(37) on d5c8e655. The latter is a colored capability value under Mono. preserve_custom_channels marks every authored targeted Custom channel as profile-exact, causing bind_profile_slot to bypass canonical downgrade. Foreground and underline share the same mechanism.
findings.requested_change: Retain authored rule precedence without treating its arbitrary raw colors as exact level-profile colors. Preserve canonical downgrade for profile-free consumers and explicit ordinary rules; add the unchanged regression through bind_defaults and bind_defaults_with_explicit.
